subject: POC kickoff recap + 48h checklist and ownership
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leah Thompson <leah@railworks.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@railworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff recap + 48h checklist and ownership

Thanks again for a productive kickoff this morning — good alignment on scope and what success looks like. I promised a short written recap + the first 48h checklist so we have a clear set of owners and immediate next steps.

High-level success criteria (agreed):
- Demonstrate end-to-end quality: <= 5% drop in retrieval relevance on our sample queries vs baseline for the three primary verticals (Maintenance, Logistics, Safety).
- Latency under 350ms p95 for the evaluation traffic shape (burst-aware).
- Data handling: no customer PII persisted outside your VPC; audit logs available for the trial window.

Evaluation plan (how we’ll measure):
- Environment: ephemeral POC instance (Redwood-managed) in us-west.
- Data: you to share a 25k-row sample dataset + 50 representative queries and expected labels (Devon to share link).
- Tests: relevance sweep, latency profile, and an integration smoke test with your search UI (Devon to confirm test endpoint).

48h checklist (owners + target):
1) Redwood: provision POC instance, preload model variant, create service credentials (target: within 48 hours) — owner: Karthik Iyer.
2) Customer: share dataset + test queries, and nominate procurement contact for contracting notes — owner: Leah / Devon (please loop Amir for procurement).
3) Redwood: send a short security snapshot and the POC success metrics workbook — owner: me (attached).
4) Both: schedule a 30-min sync mid-week to confirm environment and run the first smoke integration.

Attachments included in this message: poc-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB) — contains the evaluation rubric and scoring; redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (PDF, 210KB) — high-level data handling & controls.

Next immediate asks (can you please):
- Leah/Devon: share the dataset link + the 50 queries by EOD tomorrow.
- Confirm procurement contact (Amir?) so we can share the minimal MSA + SOC2 excerpts.
- Confirm whether you want SSO (SAML) for the POC or simple API keys (we can support both).

If everything looks good I’ll chalk the provisioning task for Karthik and we’ll ping when the instance is live. Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Leah Thompson <leah@railworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@railworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap + 48h checklist and ownership

Thanks Marissa — this is great, very clear. Quick answers from our side:
- I’ll drop the 25k sample + 50 queries into the shared Drive folder by EOD tomorrow: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/railworks-sample (Devon is listed as owner).
- Procurement: please loop Amir Singh (amir@railworks.com) — he handles POCs under $25k and will need the MSA + SOC2 excerpt.
- Integration: yes, we want the smoke test to run against our staging search UI (staging-search.railworks.internal). I’ll confirm the test endpoint and auth details in the Drive doc.
- SSO: we prefer SAML (IdP is Okta), but API keys are fine as fallback for the first day.

Can you confirm whether the ephemeral instance will have outbound access to our staging cluster for the smoke integration, or whether we should expect to pull results from Redwood and relay them into staging?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to finalize internal approvals this week.

Best,
Leah
Director of Product | RailWorks Inc.
leah@railworks.com

Hi all — small weekly check-in and nudges to keep momentum. Quick status:
- Redwood has provisioned the ephemeral instance; Karthik confirmed health checks and model staging.
- We received the sample dataset from Leah (thanks) and started the ingest test.
- Pending: procurement confirmation from Amir; SAML setup (opt-in) vs API key fallback.

Actions I need this week:
1) Amir (procurement) — can you confirm you received the minimal MSA + SOC2 excerpt (I just shared via HubSpot secure link)? If there are redlines we should capture them now so legal can triage.
2) Devon — please confirm the staging search endpoint to use for the smoke integration and whether we should expect outbound calls from the POC instance or a pull-based integration.
3) Leah — confirm whether your security team needs an IP allowlist for the POC (if yes, please provide the CIDR range).

Meeting: I’ve proposed a 30-min sync on Wed 20 May at 10:00 AM PT to validate the first smoke run and review initial metrics. Please accept if that works.

If you prefer a different cadence, say so — otherwise we’ll use Wed as the working check-in. Attached again: poc-success-metrics.xlsx (shows the scoring thresholds).

Thanks — small wins here are visible; let’s keep this tight for decision-readiness at the end of week two.

—
